---
title: Filter states
---

# Filter states

Every chart is read with its second filter option chosen; the texts on the chart must be that option's values.

```chart
type: histogram
title: Ages by region
data:
  inline:
    - {region: North, age: 20}
    - {region: North, age: 22}
    - {region: North, age: 24}
    - {region: North, age: 25}
    - {region: North, age: 26}
    - {region: North, age: 28}
    - {region: North, age: 30}
    - {region: North, age: 31}
    - {region: South, age: 60}
    - {region: South, age: 62}
    - {region: South, age: 65}
    - {region: South, age: 70}
    - {region: South, age: 72}
    - {region: South, age: 75}
    - {region: South, age: 80}
    - {region: South, age: 85}
    - {region: South, age: 88}
    - {region: South, age: 90}
encoding: {x: age}
controls:
  - kind: filter
    id: region
    field: region
    label: Region
    options: [North, South]
    initial: North
```

```chart
type: pie
title: Answers by region
data:
  inline:

    - {region: North, a: No, n: 25}
    - {region: North, a: Maybe, n: 20}
    - {region: North, a: Later, n: 10}
    - {region: North, a: Never, n: 6}
    - {region: South, a: Yes, n: 5}
    - {region: South, a: No, n: 5}
    - {region: South, a: Maybe, n: 5}
    - {region: South, a: Later, n: 5}
    - {region: South, a: Never, n: 80}
encoding: {x: a, y: n}
controls:
  - kind: filter
    id: region
    field: region
    label: Region
    options: [North, South]

```
